description: Series of cropmarks and ditches, primarily understood as a field system. Wide spread of metal finds were recovered providing a 2nd - 4th CE date with some hints at earlier occupation based on coin finds. Based on the nature of the finds the RSRB has put forward the possibility they are a ritual deposit, and has tagged the site as a 'shrine', despite any structural evidence.
bibliography: Allen, Martyn, Tom Brindle, Alex Smith, Julian D Richards, Tim Evans, Neil Holbrook, Michael Fulford, and Nathan Blick. “The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: An Online Resource.” Archaeology Data Service, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
